lead: A dossier `directive:` slice's claim is often already pinned elsewhere in the same crate, and the pack points only at the registry row.
body: `[trace] sample`'s bounds are an `export.rs` unit test and `[opcache]`'s revalidation semantics are two cases in `crates/nvs-config/tests/snapshot.rs`, so a registry case written from the rule alone re-asserts one of those under a new name. Grep the crate for the key before writing, and assert the field those cases do not read — the blanket over the keys a block *accepts* for one whose semantics are pinned, `Apply` for one whose class is.
